leo_growth: Heads-up: for next week's launch post + webinar we want a more robust bench narrative than the quick heatmap. Can runtime run a multi-dimension sweep: seq-length bins + batch-size sweep so we can show tradeoffs in copy?
alex_runtime: Sure. Can you enumerate exact axes and artifacts you need? Also tell us which infra to use (staging vs dedicated).
leo_growth: Need these axes: seq bins = 0-256, 257-1024, 1025-8192; batch sizes = 1, 2, 4, 8. For each combo we want p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and coldstart vs warmed curves. Also raw per-request CSV with seed id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, worker_id, and trace URLs. Give us heatmaps for latency and throughput and a short CSV summary for slide tables.
tara_data: I'll produce the randomized payloads (stratified by seq length) and a 25-example quickset for the slide demo. Will upload to gs://redwood-marketing/bench-samples/launch-sweep-1805559999.json by EOD.
alex_runtime: OK actionable. Need model + variant + quant config + target pool. Also confirm warmup (how many warmup per worker) and steady duration. This run is large; we'll parallelize across 4 workers but staging quota may throttle.
leo_growth: Model: `redwood/open-13b-alpha` variant `latency-tuned`, quant: `int8-optim`. Run on `staging-dedicated-2` to isolate. Warmup: 5 per worker, then steady 90s per combo. Target sample: 300 successful requests per (seq_bin,batch_size) combo. That yields ~3.6k total requests; fine to spread over a 4h window.
sam_sre: @alex_runtime I'll reserve the pool for the 4h window but cost will be ~ $2.3k in staging credits. If you want to trim to 150 per combo, we can half the cost and finish faster. Also note long sequences >4k will stress kv cache; ensure worker memory flags are on.
maya_legal: A couple legal asks: 1) include run manifest with exact commit hash + tokenizer + seed RNG seed so we can reproduce; 2) provide suggested dropdown phrasing for claims and a conservative fallback line for PR.
alex_runtime: We'll produce `run_manifest.json` and `run_notes.md` documenting rng seed, commit hash, kernel flags, tokenizer version, and compilation options. Artifacts: `latency_rows.csv`, `heatmap_latency.png`, `heatmap_throughput.png`, `summary_table.csv`. Schedule: can start tomorrow 07:30 PST, estimate finish by 11:45 PST if we keep 4 workers.
run-bot: bench-run #901 queued by alex_runtime on staging-dedicated-2 at 2026-03-25T07:30:00Z  status: scheduled.
tara_data: Uploaded sample payloads and mini-demo set: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-samples/launch-sweep-1805559999.json (includes 25-example demo).
leo_growth: Great. Two final things: 1) flag any combos we decide to omit from slides (e.g., any p99 > 5s) and 2) annotate if quantization produced any OOMs or compilation fallbacks. Need artifacts by Friday EOD for final slide copy. :raised_hands:
